criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: the new generator tests pass, covering Glossary sorted alphabetically, no claim listing the same source twice, and claims in numeric order (c33 before c34).
criteria.evidence: 22 site tests passed. They include the_glossary_is_sorted_alphabetically_whatever_the_data_order (the data order is reversed to worker, guard), claims_are_listed_in_numeric_order_and_no_claim_repeats_a_source (claims c10, c1, c9 come out as c1, c9, c10, and a repeated a.md:3-3 shows once), and the_real_study_orders_claims_and_repeats_no_source, which checks that claim numbers strictly increase on the real page. These tests would fail without the generator changes.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check: both clean.
criteria.evidence: fmt printed nothing. clippy finished with no warnings. Athena's workspace-wide clippy run also passed.

criteria.criterion: In the generated page, captain, yolo, green, red and local-only landing are defined at first use in 'Start here' or link to Glossary entries; the Glossary has entries for green, red and home.
criteria.evidence: site.rs renders a 'Words used first' <dl> between the Start here heading and 'What firstmate is', built from intro.json start_terms (captain, yolo, green, red, local-only landing, home). The test the_real_page_titles_each_design_choice_and_defines_the_start_here_terms checks that each term's <dt> appears before 'What firstmate is'. The test the_glossary_is_sorted_alphabetically_whatever_the_data_order checks that green, red and home are in the real Glossary.

criteria.criterion: Glossary entries render in alphabetical order, and claims render in numeric order with no claim showing a repeated source (c2, c14, c42 fixed).
criteria.evidence: The generator uses sort_by_cached_key on the lowercased term and claim_key, which parses the number after 'c', and keeps a BTreeSet of path:start-end strings for each claim. Both real-study tests passed: the Glossary is sorted, claim numbers strictly increase, and no <code> source repeats within any claim, which covers c2, c14 and c42.

criteria.criterion: Each design-choice card ra1–ra6 shows a short descriptive title alongside its id.
criteria.evidence:
intro.json gives rationale_titles for ra1–ra6 (for example 'Spawn at capacity exits 75 and defers'). Each card renders as '

raN title'. A test checks each title is present and not empty on the real page, and a_rationale_without_a_title_is_an_error passed.

criteria.criterion: The lede either explains the internal id firstmate-work-handling or no longer shows it unexplained.
criteria.evidence: The lede now reads 'Its study id, {id}, is the name of the folder under studies/ that holds the data this page is generated from.' A test asserts this text is on the real page.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo run for the site generator xtask (as documented) and confirm the output page contains the new titles and definitions; the generator must still validate the study.
criteria.evidence: The generator printed 'wrote .../target/verify/site/index.html', so render() accepted the study: every claim id cites a known claim and no title or element is missing. Policy blocked me from reading that file because it is outside my working directory, so I confirmed its content with the tests, which render the same real study through the same function. claims.json and the files checked by the study schema are unchanged, so validation.json is unaffected.

findings.summary: The design doc's Checks list does not mention the new behavior or tests
findings.evidence: The doc lists the site tests and describes the intro.json fields, but does not mention start_terms, rationale_titles, glossary sorting, claim ordering or source de-duplication. The file is not in the deliverables list, so this is for later.

findings.summary: The 'green' definition is an inference, not a direct claim
findings.evidence: 'A PR that is not red' cites c26 and c28. Neither claim defines green; c28 defines red, and c26 uses green without defining it. The inference is reasonable, but the cited text does not state it.

findings.summary: The 'Start here' definition of home differs from the Glossary entry
findings.evidence: Start here says 'the place that holds a backlog of tasks'. The Glossary says 'the place where firstmate keeps a backlog and the records of its tasks...'. They don't contradict each other, but the wording is not the same.

summary: The change fixes every point in the newcomer's rating, and the fixes live in the generator wherever they are systematic. xtask/src/site.rs now sorts the Glossary case-insensitively, lists claims by their number (so c33 comes before c34), shows each source location only once per claim, requires every design-choice card to have a title, and explains the study id in the lede. The study's intro.json adds a "Words used first" list in Start here that defines captain, yolo, green, red, local-only landing and home. It also adds Glossary entries for green, red and home, and titles for ra1–ra6. New tests cover the synthetic case and the real study: the sorted Glossary, numeric claim order, no repeated source, the card titles, the term definitions, and an error for a missing title. I ran the 22 site tests, clippy and fmt; all passed. I also ran `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, which wrote the page. Policy stopped me from reading that output file because it sits outside my working directory, so my evidence for the rendered content comes from the tests, which render the real study. Only CHANGELOG.md, intro.json and site.rs changed, all within the expected deliverables. Two minor issues remain: the design doc's Checks list was not updated, and the "green" definition is drawn from claims c26 and c28 rather than stated in either one.
